dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregularly shaped, high-contrast closed loops and semi-closed 'C' structures are present on the dorsal-lateral surface. The perimeters exhibit a sharp gradient from dark-tone boundaries to light-tone interiors, with undulating edges particularly on the structures located mid-body.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, dark, solid-tone blobs concentrated on the cephalic and cervical regions. Lower density of larger, irregular high-intensity pixel clusters dispersed among the macro-annuli on the mid-dorsal trunk.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli on the mid-back define an elongated, irregular quadrilateral; the spatial relationship between the two most cranial centroids shows a wider horizontal displacement compared to the two most caudal centroids.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, high-intensity light-colored arc is visible immediately posterior to the ocular region, contrasting sharply with the surrounding dark-toned cephalic texture.
